title: Boundedness after finite coefficient reduction
statement: theorem point_sections_finite_reduction_bounded (_hl : IsUnit (l : k)) : ∀ (n j : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjn : j ≤ n), (∀ N : (pointFiniteReductionBoundedAbove k l E n).FullSubcategory, pointFiniteReductionBoundedAbove k l E j ((pointFiniteReductionSheafTensor k l E n j hjn).obj N.obj) ∧ ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, b < q → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj ((pointFiniteReductionModuleTensor l E n j hjn).obj ((pointFiniteReductionSections k l E n).obj N.obj))))

proof.text: Use the bounded-above flat model constructed in the comparison proof. Ordinary additive sheaf extension preserves its zero terms above a bound. The K-flat counit and the model isomorphism identify its derived scalar extension with the image of this bounded-above complex, transferring the upper bound.

Exact point sections preserve the derived upper bound. Apply the existing module derived-tensor upper-bound theorem to the degree-zero quotient coefficient complex, then express IsLE as homology vanishing.
